verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs describe downloading and running local LLMs (Llama, Qwen, gpt-oss) via Hugging Face search, and explicitly state its backend uses llama.cpp (and Apple MLX) for completions/embeddings, which is the standard GGUF-serving engine; community posts corroborate easy download-and-run workflows on Windows/Mac. However, the evidence never explicitly names 'GGUF' format, so support is inferred rather than directly documented. missing for 10: explicit mention of GGUF format support, independent confirmation of GGUF file loading specifically.
